linkedin:
Amplify bundles hosting, auth, and APIs on top of many separate AWS services and a generated CloudFormation stack.

That's fast to start with and awkward to debug and forecast once you scale. A calmer AWS Amplify alternative for a full-stack app is a managed server that runs your frontend and your own backend, with a managed database and S3-compatible object storage beside it, all in one dashboard from $8/mo flat. One honest caveat up front: Amplify's Cognito auth and AppSync GraphQL are AWS-managed services, so on your own stack you bring your own auth library and API framework instead.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/aws-amplify-alternative/
